summary.name: PUN_DRVO
summary.title: DRVO PUNO
summary.concept: a solid tree: growth rings (spiral) with a shear-bonding lines layer every third layer; the canopy flare is bounded per layer

machineQualification.beadEvidence: carried over from the A2L; never calibrated on this machine — run the C1 thin-wall test on the A1 and measure before trusting

gatePolicy.meaning: a solid body: every span between fill crossings must be a legal bridge; nothing is declared experimental

solid.basePolicy: 5 solid layers (first at 0.50 mm spacing, then 0.85)
